series.title: MF HOBO Deep — temperature · Jun–Oct 2016

location.location: Martha's Finyard, Little Cayman — probable MF site reference
location.coordinate_basis: Probable identification: MF = Martha's Finyard. NCBI BioSample SAMN55782138 uses MF in its sample name, explicitly names Martha's Finyard, and reports 19.66487 N, 80.11118 W. These agree with the supplied DoE January 2023 mooring 237 coordinates. This supports an abbreviation match, not confirmation of the 2016 deployment or logger positions.
location.coordinate_scope: tentative site / mooring reference; not a verified logger position

series.timezone_interpretation: UTC−05:00 assumed from source CDT label for June–October 2016; clock configuration unverified
